thesis: Ben Thompson argues that the primary concern regarding powerful AI is not the morality of government restrictions but the strategic risk of unilateral actions inviting worse outcomes from adversaries like China. He contends that a safer equilibrium exists if the US allows China to depend on Taiwan for chip manufacturing rather than attempting to cut China off while maintaining US dependence on Taiwan.
